title: Geofence Policy Executor and Tenant Allow/Deny Sampler
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a policy executor and lightweight sampling mechanism that evaluates tenant-scoped geofence rules (EU-only, residency constraints, customer allowlists/denylists) at request ingress and emits decisions used by routing, tier selection, and fallback model variant selection. This ticket covers runtime enforcement glue, an audit-emitting sampler for noisy rules, and an integration spec for Console/Policy UI to preview soft-blocks before hard enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: Policy executor can evaluate per-tenant rules in <2ms p50 under baseline throughput and attach a routing_decision header to requests
Allowlist/denylist checks support exact tenant IDs and regex-based customer attributes; denylist takes precedence unless configured otherwise

When a rule is soft=true (preview), the sampler emits 1% of matching requests to audit-log and analytics pipeline; when soft=false, routing decision enforces local egress region and model variant constraints

Fallback behavior: if primary EU-only pool is unavailable, executor selects fallback variant per tenant policy (same-residency variant first, then alternate-tier with encrypted egress), and SLOs documented
End-to-end integration tests exist covering allow -> deny transitions, emergency passthrough toggle, and tenant-scoped override precedence
Console shows a preview count for soft rules (last 24h) and a link to sampled audit logs
Telemetry: every decision emits policy_id, rule_version, decision, rationale, and sampling_flag to observability topic
technical_notes: Design: small in-process policy evaluator (WASM or limited DSL) with fast path cache keyed by tenant+policy_hash
Rule model: tenant policies map to conditions (geo, retention, customer_tags) and actions (route_to_pool, circuit_break, block, sample) with version metadata
Performance: micro-benchmark target is <2ms p50 with 10k qps worker; use a 128-entry LRU cache for policy lookups to avoid DB hit on common tenants
Fallback selection: prefer pinned model variants in same jurisdiction; if none, use encrypted egress via 'secure-egress' pool with explicit audit flag
Data plane implication: add routing_decision headers and policy.audit_id to request context for downstream tracing and billing correlation
Persistence: policy definitions stored in control-plane Postgres with change streams to push diffs to nodes; use optimistic versioning to avoid races
Security: policy evaluation must not leak tenant identifiers in logs; sampled audit events are redacted and stored in a restricted S3 bucket with KMS encryption
tradeoffs: In-process evaluator vs remote PDP: in-process reduces latency but increases memory footprint and rollout complexity; we choose in-process with a small WASM sandbox to balance latency and isolation
Sampling rate of 1% may miss low-frequency violations; increasing sampling affects pipeline cost—start small and iterate based on detection signals
Allowlist precedence vs denylist precedence: choosing denylist-first simplifies emergency blocks but requires careful UI affordance to prevent accidental tenant-wide blocks
test_plan: Unit tests for policy DSL parser and matcher coverage (geo, tenant_attr, regex)
Load test of evaluator at 10k qps across 8 shards with realistic tenant distribution using k6
Integration test: injected failure of EU pool triggers fallback selection and verifies encrypted-egress path
Chaos test: toggling emergency_passthrough flag should immediately allow previously-denied tenants and emit audit event
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (preview): deploy eval-only mode for 10% of hosts with sampling enabled for selected enterprise tenants
Phase 2 (soft-enforce): enable soft=true enforcement for non-critical tenants and surface counts in Console
Phase 3 (hard-enforce): enable hard enforcement for high-risk tenant cohorts with monitoring alerts and rollback playbook
Rollback: control-plane feature flag to revert to noop; nodes subscribe to feature flag and expire policy cache immediately
monitoring: Alert: error rate >0.5% for policy evaluator across region for 5m
Alert: fallback_rate >5% for an EU pool triggers capacity investigation
Dashboards: per-tenant preview counts, sampled-audit-volume, enforcement-impact on latency/cost
